# Amazon ML Challenge Explorer (LLM Context & AI Agent Sitemap)
> An independent leaderboard explorer, universal search engine, and institutional analytics platform for the Amazon ML Challenge 2026 dataset.

## Platform Identity & Overview
- Website: https://amazonmlchallengeexplorer.vercel.app
- Challenge Name: Amazon ML Challenge 2026
- Challenge ID: 290344
- Competition Type: Machine Learning / CodeContest
- Source Platform: Public Unstop Leaderboard Endpoint
- Historical Snapshot Scope: 114/114 complete leaderboard pages (100% complete archive)
- Dataset Dimensions:
  - 4,334 total teams and finalized submission records
  - 14,480 registered student participants
  - 1,546 unique academic institutions and engineering colleges

## Independence & Non-Affiliation Notice
- Amazon ML Challenge Explorer is an independent data analysis and community exploration tool.
- This platform is NOT affiliated with, maintained by, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon, Unstop, or official competition organizers.
- The leaderboard data represents an immutable historical snapshot collected from the public competition leaderboard.
- Institutional metrics (such as college rankings, score distributions, and inter-college team detection) are derived analytically from the snapshot dataset.

## Primary Routes & URLs
- `/` - Main Explorer Dashboard: In-memory search across teams, student member names, and universities.
- `/leaderboard` - Official Team Standings: Complete 4,334-team rankings with filters by rank tiers (Top 10, Top 25, Top 50, Top 100) and team roster sizes (1 to 4+ members).
- `/leaderboard/colleges` - College Leaderboard: Analytical ranking of 1,546 universities by composite performance score, top team finish, top-5 average rank, and score percentiles.
- `/leaderboard/inter-college` - Inter-College Teams: Catalog of teams formed by students collaborating across 2 or more distinct universities.
- `/organizations` - Colleges & Universities Directory: Searchable index of 1,546 academic institutions.
- `/organizations/[slug]` - College Profile Page: Specific university entity page detailing participating teams, student rosters, best rank, and score distributions.
- `/teams/[teamId]` - Team Profile Page: Specific team entity page displaying official leaderboard rank, evaluation score, finish timestamp, participant roster, and college affiliations.
- `/compare` - Institutional Comparison Tool: Multi-university comparison comparing team counts, top finishes, and score percentiles.
- `/cross-college` - Cross-College Collaborations: High-density directory of multi-institutional teams.
- `/about` - About Platform: Mission, capabilities, dataset dimensions, and project overview.
- `/methodology` - Methodology & Algorithms: Technical documentation on data normalization, college scoring formulas, and inter-college detection.
- `/data-sources` - Data Sources & Provenance: Public endpoint attribution, completeness verification, and static snapshot architecture.
- `/privacy` - Privacy Policy: Information on privacy-safe search, cookie/local storage usage, and Google Analytics consent controls.
- `/terms` - Terms of Use: Informational exploration scope, acceptable use, and limitation of liability.
- `/contact` - Contact & Inquiries: Platform inquiry and documentation channels.

## Data Interpretation & Metric Definitions
- **Scores**: Competition evaluation metric range from 0.000000 to 1.000000.
- **Ranks**: Ordered by evaluation score descending, with submission timestamp tiebreakers where applicable.
- **Colleges & Affiliations**: Normalized from self-reported university names during team registration.
- **Inter-College Teams**: Defined as any team whose registered student members report 2 or more distinct academic institutions.
- **Top-5 Average Rank**: Arithmetic mean rank of the top 5 highest-performing teams from a specific institution.
